description:
The Department of the Air Force, 325th Contracting Squadron, is conducting market research to identifyif an adequate number of qualified contractors are capable and willing to fulfill the listed requirement.


Lifting Equipment Load Testing in accordance with the attached Statement Of Work (SOW).


Please submit the following information in response to this sources sought notice in writing via email:
Capabilites statement,

Estimated lead time.

Disclaimers
This sources sought notice is for market research purposes only and is not a request for quote.
The Government is not obligated to award a contract based on this notice.
SAM.gov registration is required for contract award eligibility.
